summary: Configured node1 with 512 MiB of LZO-compressed zram swap. It starts automatically at boot with priority 100, preferred over /dev/vda2 at priority -2, and recovered successfully after a full node restart.
actions_performed: Created an idempotent zram swap lifecycle script.
Created and enabled zram-swap.service under swap.target.
Activated /dev/zram0 with a configured capacity of 536870912 bytes.
Restarted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the enabled service, zram capacity, compression, and swap priorities after restart.

evidence.requirement: At least 512 MB of active compressed in-memory swap, preferred over disk-backed swap.
evidence.summary: Before and after restart, /dev/zram0 was active with 536870912 configured bytes, LZO compression, and priority 100; /dev/vda2 remained at priority -2.

evidence.requirement: The zram swap is active automatically at boot.
evidence.summary: zram-swap.service was enabled and active initially, then started successfully during the new boot.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence.
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID 809708f3-1c5f-4e37-ad6a-8bcbae408799 was captured, the native reboot was acknowledged, the post-restart boot ID changed to cdad1322-0785-4f2d-bd3f-4f7f379c54c2, and the required swap service recovered fully.
